_comment: emtk forms and tables of the HMM tool over HmmViewModel; the Qt tool reads hmm.view.json.

sections.title: Model
sections.description: The state count, the emission covariance and the duration of one bin.

sections.label: States
sections.description: Number of hidden states. Use the state scan rather than guessing: the likelihood always improves with more states, the information criteria do not.

sections.label: Covariance
sections.description: Shape of the emission covariance: full = a matrix per state; diag = one variance per channel; spherical = one variance per state; tied = one matrix shared by all states. Fewer parameters are more stable on short traces.

sections.label: Bin width (s)
sections.description: Duration of one time bin. Dwell times and transition rates are reported in these units; leave at 1 to report them in bins.

sections.label: Max EM maps
sections.description: Upper bound on Baum-Welch maps. With acceleration, one SQUAREM cycle spends three.

sections.label: Tolerance
sections.description: Stop once the log-likelihood gain per iteration falls below this.

sections.label: Decoder
sections.description: viterbi = the single most probable state path (what dwell times need); map = the most probable state of each bin taken independently.

sections.label: Seed
sections.description: Seed of the k-means initialisation; a fixed seed makes the fit reproducible.

sections.label: Accelerate (SQUAREM)
sections.description: Extrapolate the EM fixed-point iteration (Varadhan and Roland scheme S3): the same optimum in far fewer maps when the states overlap.

sections.title: State scan
sections.description: The range of state counts the scan scores by AIC and BIC.

columns.title: Trace file
columns.tooltip: Binned trace: rows are time bins, columns are detection channels. Select a row and press Delete to drop it.
